ContextBoundary.description:
Named neighboring context selected by the delegating Agent.

A boundary records semantic entry/exit context for a WorkOrder.  It may
anchor that guidance to exact canonical artifact pointers when such an

without a neighboring artifact.  It never copies or owns project content.

ContextPack.description:
Bounded context assembled for one agent call.

Runtime callers keep the complete typed memories so local validation can
still work with exact :class:`ArtifactRef` objects.  The model-facing JSON
projection serializes each unique reference once in ``artifact_index``;
memories and action digests point to the compact index ids instead of
replaying the same four-field object dozens of times.

operation.description: GENERATE: no reference images or target parent. text_anchor.description: 新正文引用优先复制唯一原文 exact；重复时补紧邻的 prefix/suffix，无需手算位置。基于所属 Shot 或 Beat 的 field 定位，保存为规范 text_start/text_end。同时提供显式偏移时必须与唯一匹配一致；此输入提示不另存为引用状态。

text_start.description: 已有人工选区的起始 Unicode 字符位置（包含起点，不按 UTF-16 计数），与 text_end 成对。新引用可改传 text_anchor，由程序定位；保留已有偏移和自定义 alias。仅不对应任何正文文字的整镜构图参考才省略。

StoryboardSourceRange.description:
A semantic source span selected by the Leader, not a timed chunk.

A range may cover part of one scene or cross scene boundaries.  Dialogue
line IDs provide exact traceability where the script has spoken lines;
natural-language anchors retain action-only beats without inventing a
second screenplay representation.
StoryboardSourceRange.title: StoryboardSourceRange

StoryboardTimingAudit.description:
Persisted summary of MiniMax Design's private timing scratch pass.

Neither a source declaration nor a target may be divided into synthetic
ClipGroup budgets. ``computed_episode_duration_s`` is derived from the
natural ledger and is then compared with the pinned DurationContract.
StoryboardTimingAudit.title: StoryboardTimingAudit

StoryboardTimingLedgerEntry.description: One dialogue or visible-action row in the private timing ledger.

non_speech_reserve_seconds.description: This row's incremental non-speech time after dialogue, action, reaction, and camera beats that can play concurrently have been collapsed. It is not a per-row copy of the ClipGroup's shared performance reserve.

StoryboardTimingLedgerEntry.title: StoryboardTimingLedgerEntry

StoryboardWorkUnitContract.description:
One dynamically planned authoring scope carried by an Agent WorkOrder.

This contract deliberately does not equate a WorkOrder with a script scene,
an editorial Shot, or a provider ClipGroup.  One unit may produce multiple
groups, and a later Leader revision may split or combine semantic ranges.
